mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level exceeding 850 thousand units (HOUST > 850) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 5-day periods following HOUST > 850.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, signaling strong economic activity and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following a simultaneous PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: A robust industrial production level (INDPRO > 99) reflects strong supply capacity, reducing inflation concerns and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods when INDPRO > 99.

mechanism_narrative: A high retail sales level (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer spending, a key driver of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 5-day periods following RSAFS > 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 230 indicates elevated inflation, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, reducing equity valuations and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals a strong economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economic expansion with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 5.0%), the economy is near its peak, leading to overvaluation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the 5-day periods during UNRATE < 5.0%.
